source.study: Watkins et al. — Arbitrary mechanical memory encoding via nonlinear waves in bistable metamaterials

data_firewall.rule: do not claim XIV-3 prospective credit from already-published experiments; use as frozen confirmatory raw-data test and material H/m/R benchmark

hypothesis: For physical experimental trials, the measured temporal shape of the input carries predictive information about the final three-bit state beyond initial state and nominal static forcing descriptors.
primary_metric: exact-match accuracy of final three-bit state
competitors: same-complexity H permuted within initial-state strata
validation: hold out complete experimental trials and group repeated measurements from one trial together
failure_rule: gain < 10 percentage points or bootstrap lower bound <= 0 or permutation p > 0.05
non_testable_rule: if trial-level H and R cannot be reconstructed from exp.zip, report non_testable without metric substitution
